text: {"lessons":["Selling several winners early felt good, but I should use a planned exit rule rather than let the pleasure of locking in gains drive every sale.","I held through declines and eventually sold Stock B at a large loss; I should review positions objectively and act on my plan instead of avoiding the pain of admitting a mistake.","My repeated Stock D trades added activity without a clear long-term plan; before buying or selling, I should define the reason, risk limit, and intended holding period."]}
